title: GridField read-only table prints a select cell's stored value and a currency / number cell's raw number: only file and temporal columns go through displayText
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured renderer defect with a named site, from the os-dev report on objectui#12854 (PR #12914, out-of-scope finding, class a). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

**reach:** a renderer-level measurement (the dev's pin, plus this seat's read of `main`); not yet driven through a public door in a browser. It now has a direct producer: after PR #12914, a `record:line_items` column listed by `name` takes its `type` from the child field, so a read-only line-items table (a read-only record page, or a print page if it renders read-only) gets real `select` / `currency` / `number` columns.

## What happens (objectui `main`, `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`)

- `displayText(c, value, locale, currency)` already formats every type: a `select` value as its option label, `currency` and the numeric types in the declared locale, and temporal and file values.
- The **read-only table** cell (the `readonly` surface, which replaces the inputs) sends only `lookup` (to `LookupField`) and `file` / temporal columns through `displayText`. Every other column falls to `String(row[c.name])`. So a select cell prints its stored value (`open`, not `Open`), and a currency or number cell prints the raw number (`1234.5`, not `$1,234.50`), ungrouped and in no locale.
- The same holds for any read-only `GridField`, master-detail included.

## Wanted

The read-only table cell renders every non-lookup column through `displayText`, the formatter the editable surface's display path already uses, so a select reads its option label and a numeric or currency cell reads in the declared locale. Done when a pin beside `GridField` renders a read-only table with `select`, `currency` and `number` columns and asserts the option label and the locale-formatted amounts, with a control that `lookup`, `file` and temporal cells are unchanged.

Dedupe: `search_issues` in objectui for "GridField readonly table select cell shows stored value not option label displayText": 5 results (objectui#12584, #3986, #3566, #3393, #2360, all closed). The nearest, #3566, is the date-column gap the temporal branch closed. None names the select or numeric cells.
